decisive_items: it demonstrated a thin rim of enhancement with no internal enhancement
intermediate in signal intensity on T1-weighted images and homogeneously low in signal on T2-weighted images
response.rationale: R3 is favored because the thin rim enhancement with no internal enhancement and homogeneous low T2 signal are characteristic of meningioma, whereas schwannoma typically shows intense enhancement and heterogeneous signal. The location and extra-axial nature are common to both.
